name: Quick Select Wheel
description: A radial quick-select section for items, abilities, emotes, or tools. It owns slot geometry, directional focus, hold-versus-toggle behavior, and selection requests; it does not grant items, trigger abilities, or change a loadout without the responsible gameplay component accepting the request.

inputs.name: slots
inputs.description: Host-supplied slots as {id, label, icon, enabled, count, cooldownFraction}; empty slots remain addressable and visibly empty.

inputs.name: selectionMode
inputs.description: hold confirms on release; toggle keeps the wheel open until explicit confirmation or close.

outputs.name: slotRegions
outputs.description: Radial hit regions in stable slot order, including disabled and empty slots.
